literal: Like the joining of a metal box, even if they join, they will not truly unite, the family beset with internal enmity.
translation: Even if they seem to fit together closely like the lid and a casket, a family beset with internal enmity will never truly unite.
modern: உட்பகை கொண்ட குடும்பத்தினர், செப்பின் மூடியும் உடலும் பொருந்துவது போல வெளியில் கூடி வாழ்ந்தாலும், மனதால் ஒருபோதும் ஒன்றாக இணைய மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet uses the vivid metaphor of a metal box (செப்பு) and its lid. Although the lid and the box fit together so perfectly that they appear to be a single unit from the outside, they remain two separate pieces that never actually fuse. Similarly, members of a family (குடி) who harbor internal hatred (உட்பகை) may live together and appear united to the world, but their hearts and minds remain completely divided and can never truly bond.
